findings.scenario: TypeScript class `class User { constructor(public address: Address) {} }`. The parameter property `address` is a public class member, but the widened gate now re-keys it as a function-local of the constructor: `Property:u.ts:User.constructor.address@2:14` instead of `Property:u.ts:User.address`. Its id now contains a source position, so any edit above the constructor changes the id of a class member. That churns incremental and stored references to it and breaks the documented contract that class-member ids are untouched.
findings.evidence: `nestedCallablePrefix` now applies to every label for which `isPositionQualifiedLocalLabel` is true, which includes Property (callable-labels.ts:47). In `qualifiedName` it takes precedence over `enclosingClassInfo`. The TS query captures `(required_parameter (accessibility_modifier) pattern: (identifier)) @definition.property` (tree-sitter-queries.ts:394-396), whose definitionNode sits inside the constructor's `method_definition`. `enclosingCallablePrefix` then finds the constructor before reaching the class_body boundary. The same function already carves this case out for ownership (`isFunctionLocalProperty` checks PARAMETER_LIST_NODE_TYPES: parameter properties are class members), but the new prefix path ignores that carve-out. I confirmed this by running the pipeline on a fresh build of the diff: nodes were ["Property:u.ts:Address.city", "Property:u.ts:User.constructor.address@2:14"], with `HAS_PROPERTY Class:u.ts:User -> Property:u.ts:User.constructor.address@2:14` and ACCESSES from `User.show#0` and from the free function `f` pointing at the position-bearing id. No existing test pins the id of a parameter property (test/integration/resolvers/typescript.test.ts passes either way).
findings.recommendation: Apply the nesting prefix to a Property only when it really is function-local. For example, gate it on `nodeLabel !== 'Property' || isFunctionLocalProperty`, or skip the prefix when `enclosingClassInfo` exists, so parameter properties keep `User.address`. Add an integration assertion that `constructor(public address: Address)` yields `Property:<file>:User.address`.
